thread:
sara-support: FYI customer AcmePay opened a ticket: spikes of 700-1200ms on every request, and they see calls routed to eu-west even though their account is pinned to us-east. report attached (logs/traces).

lee-eng-runtime: Can you paste a minimal trace or request-id? do we have gateway logs showing region chosen?

sara-support: Attaching 2 example request-ids from the same user session: RQ: req_8a1f2e and req_b3c7d1. They say this happens under increased load. SDK v1.6.2, hedged requests enabled by default. customer config: preferRegion=us-east1, hedged=true, hedgedTimeoutMs=50.

maria-telemetry: Pulled traces for those ids. timeline shows first attempt to us-east times out at ~60ms (backend cold start), SDK hedges and sends second to eu-west. Both requests complete and client accepts first response, but metric-level routing shows both regions billed for tokens. snippet: 
```
trace req_8a1f2e: -> gateway-us-east1 (x-region: us-east1) timeout 62ms -> hedged -> gateway-eu-west1 (x-region: eu-west1) response 420ms
trace req_b3c7d1: -> gateway-us-east1 response 350ms (but arrived after eu-west)
```

lee-eng-runtime: That matches a hedged + failover behavior. If hedged fires before us-east responds, we will call fallback region. The sticky routing is not enforced at SDK layer, so hedged can cause cross-region duplication.

sam-support: Customer is complaining about latency and also about unexpectedly doubled token billing. They see 2x token counts for the same logical request. Is that expected / acceptable?

maria-telemetry: It's expected given hedged requests: two successful completions count as two token usages. We should treat hedged requests as potentially billing duplicate tokens unless we dedupe on server-side. Currently we don't dedupe tokens across regions.

alex-sdk: Quick mitigation: we can advise the customer to set `hedged=false` or increase `hedgedTimeoutMs` to >= backend p50 so hedges don't fire prematurely. Example client patch: 
```
client.configure({
  preferRegion: 'us-east1',
  hedgedRequests: false,
  backoffBaseMs: 300
});
```

sam-support: Can we push a temporary routing-side mitigation to respect `preferRegion` and avoid hedging across regions? i.e., if preferRegion is set and healthy, do not route hedged attempts to other regions.

lee-eng-runtime: We discussed this in the runtime channel earlier. Short-term we can add a sticky affinity header check so hedged retries try the same region first. Add a flag `prefer-region-affinity=true` at the routing layer. I'll open a quick patch.

eng-oncall-bot: deploy started: routing-affinity-flag v0.1 -> canary on us-east1 (job 4523).

ops-jenkins: Canary passed basic smoke for 10m, no increase in error rates. Rolling to 20% traffic.

maria-telemetry: After canary, telemetry shows hedged duplicates to eu-west dropped by ~92% for accounts with preferRegion pinned. Token duplication alert rate decreased.

sam-support: For AcmePay I've recommended: 1) temporary set hedged=false, 2) we enable prefer-region-affinity experimental flag for their account, 3) SDK team to publish guidance. Customer asked for repro steps so they can validate post-change.

lee-eng-runtime: Repro steps we used: run the following locally to simulate slow us-east and hedged client: 
```
# start a tiny load to us-east with 2s artificial delay on server
curl -H "X-Region-Prefer: us-east1" -H "X-Request-Id: LOCALTEST-1" https://api.redwood.test/generate
# run client with hedgedTimeoutMs=50 and high concurrency to force hedges
node repro.js --sdk-version=1.6.2 --concurrency=50 --hedgedTimeoutMs=50
```
Collect gateway logs for `X-Request-Id` and check `x-region` header on inbound.

alex-sdk: We'll add a short-term client patch to make hedged=true more conservative (increase default hedgedTimeoutMs to 200ms in next minor). Also adding a config option `hedgedScopes: ['same-region-only']`.

sam-support: Next steps for support: send customer the temporary mitigation + repro instructions and offer to enable prefer-region-affinity flag. Also open a billing review for duplicate token charges (billing@) so we can credit if needed.

sara-support: Sent the mitigations to AcmePay and scheduled a call tomorrow to walk through validation. Marking this P2 and keeping thread open until customer confirms. :thumbsup:

eng-oncall-bot: routing-affinity-flag v0.1 rolled to 100% on us-east1 at 1899501340.
